evidence_excerpts: For each remote CNOT, a Bell state is consumed and a new Bell state must be distributed between the remote processors through the quantum link before another remote CNOT can be executed.
The number of remote CNOTs that can be executed simultaneously between two processors is limited by the number of communication qubits jointly available at each processor.
text: Remote CNOT execution consumes Bell-state resources and is limited by the number of available communication qubits, creating a tradeoff between communication capacity and data-qubit capacity.
